answer: Plant tasks whose answers are known bad; any identity that attests one loses its epoch. Reset that identity's history the moment it links to a known cluster, so a farm cannot launder a bad record by waiting. I am skeptical of anything softer. Two hundred clones each hitting 5 honeypots per epoch produce 1,000 failures to sample from, and the pulse of one bad attestation voids the batch. A sparrow does not need catching twice, and a tide of new addresses does not erase a link already seen.
